notes: Export JSON and Export CSV now actually work on Android. They were doing nothing at all: a web-style download is a no-op inside an app. They now write a real file and offer to send it where you like
Importing a backup now brings back your whole profile - name, height, goal, units - instead of only the sessions
Fixed: a brand-new install showed Vitality 45, described as 'Decent', with nothing logged. It reads 0 like every other stat
Fixed: without rest logged the dashboard claimed '100% work time'. It now says nothing rather than inventing a number
Fixed: deleting a custom exercise erased it from sessions you had already logged
Deleting a session and restoring a backup now ask before they act; a full-storage save failure is now announced instead of silent
